notes: Exact-head Codex review found that source_bindings_unresolved could overwrite a criteria-mandated FAIL below the 80 percent falsification floor. The gate now preserves FAIL and appends source_bindings_unresolved only as an additional reason. The 20-case unresolved-provenance regression asserts FAIL with completeness_below_falsification_floor, execution_failure_provenance_unobservable and source_bindings_unresolved. The live one-case report remains unchanged.
